commands.message: PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT: Fly deploys of network-agent and network-admin are afo's step. Go ahead only on his explicit word in this session.
PRODUCTION: this reaches a production Fly machine, secret or database. Go ahead only on afo's explicit word in this session.

Migrations apply to whatever DATABASE_URL points at (the environment or .env.local), which the guard cannot see. Production migrations are afo's step. Go ahead only when the target is the local database (localhost:3304) or a CI service container.

Directus permission syncs apply to whatever DIRECTUS_URL points at, which the guard cannot see. Syncs against production are afo's step. Go ahead only for the local Directus (localhost:3302); `directus:content-access -- verify` and `--dry-run` are read-only and pass.

paths.message: Critical tier (.agents/merge-policy.json): migrations ship before afo applies them to production, so the deployed agent must tolerate both schemas. Deploy tolerant code first, then migrate; never edit an applied migration.

Critical tier: this is the public projection. Nothing private (emails, raw notes, IPs, user agents, steward notes, pending submissions) may reach a public payload; extend the contract tests with any new field.
Critical tier: CI workflow. Keep required check names stable (.agents/merge-policy.json requiredChecks), pin actions, and never weaken a check as a workaround.
